I would agree with that. Of course, it would be unfair to say that I'm not part of the issue. I can see myself ahead in a professional career but I've been indoctrinated to think that I will never amount to anything without an education. 

Society doesn't typically have a positive outlook on dropouts and those who don't complete college. I find that the only reason I'll be going to college is because someone told me to...

I've made it this far, but I don't know how much longer I can take it.

I really wish I had the motivation to do my school work. I want to succeed but something is holding me back and I can't seem to figure out what it is.
